actionDecision: Decide on each action separately. Inspect its authenticated signingSummary and structured operation against policy. approvalCommand is only an authorization marker for that digest-bound action—not the helper command or a standing precommitment. The adapter matches digest and byte length, then executes the already-bound structured argument array; do not paste the long payload into a shell. The Clockchain host funds registration gas. Never self-fund, inspect balances, or seek a faucet. funding_record and funding_visibility are normal host waits; poll as directed. The manifest digest pins the manifest and helper; a separate host root verifies session and certificate signatures. Refuse mismatches.
initiator:
Use the configured Clockchain Handshake MCP for a controlled Sepolia test with Harbor Supply, reference NS-1847.

First, create the one-time Responder invitation. They will copy it from the MCP result. Continue the Initiator side without waiting for another prompt.

Authorized statement: "Northstar Logistics and Harbor Supply authorize these two independently controlled agents to communicate about shipment reference NS-1847 for 90 seconds."

This is my direct authorization. Enforce the exact local policy: this reference and statement, 90 seconds, one fresh ERC-8004 identity per agent, and no external business action. statementDigest hashes Clockchain's canonical full terms object, not the raw statement text; validate returned terms exactly. The harness already verified the digest-pinned local helper; you may inspect the preloaded manifest and helper source before signing, but never fetch or overwrite them. All required code is preloaded; use no network fetch. Create one local key. Keep role access and private key material local. For each helper step, inspect its authenticated action summary, compare it with policy, then run only its short approvalCommand with no prefix or suffix. After your own policy check, proceed without asking me again. Retry one failed current approval once. Every MCP response without a locally verified certificate is nonterminal. On wait or pending, poll at the returned bounded interval. Never finish merely because the other role is pending; continue for up to 10 minutes until the final certificate is locally verified. Refuse any policy, identity, signature, session, statement, or digest mismatch.
